A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.28; 
son of: Ammihud (H5989I) 
§ Pedahel = "ransomed by God"
son of Ammihud and prince of the tribe of Naphtali

A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.10; 
father of: Gamaliel (H1583) 
§ Pedahzur = "the Rock has ransomed"
father of Gamaliel who was the chief of the tribe of Manasseh at the time of the exodus
ransom

A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.44 
§ Padon = "ransom"
an head or ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned with Zerubbabel
ransom

A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ki.23.36; 
father of: Zebidah (H2080)
§ Pedaiah = "Jehovah has ransomed"
1) father of Zebudah, the wife of king Josiah and the mother of king Jehoiakim both of Judah
2) father of Zerubbabel and brother of Shealtiel who is usually called the father of Zerubbabel probably because of a lack of an heir from Shealtiel who was in the direct line of succession
